{"consolidated_memory":"infra/k8s/deployment.yaml: Multiple crash loop incidents in the same component

INCIDENT 1 - 2026-06-09 (Non-ASCII serialisation issue)
File: infra/k8s/deployment.yaml
Problem: Crash loop in deployment
Trigger: Records carrying non-ASCII names
Root cause: Serialiser dropping fields it did not know
Signal: Container restarting a few seconds after start
Measured outcome: Memory settled at 593 MB instead of climbing past 7 GB
Fix: Switched to strict schema that rejects unknown fields
Implementation: PR #2896, branch fix/crash-loop-4
Context: Same corner of infra/k8s/deployment.yaml as earlier crash loop work

INCIDENT 2 - 2026-06-24 (Error handling issue)
File: infra/k8s/deployment.yaml
Problem: Crash loop in deployment
Trigger: Staging read replica
Root cause: Error swallowed by bare except clause
Signal: Container restarting a few seconds after start
Measured outcome: Reclaimed 34 GB of blob storage
Fix: Narrowed the exception handler and let the failure propagate
Implementation: PR #4993, branch fix/crash-loop-6
Context: Same corner of infra/k8s/deployment.yaml as earlier crash loop work

Note: Both incidents occurred in the same infrastructure component and exhibited the same visible symptom (container restart), but had distinct root causes (serialisation vs exception handling) and required different solutions."}
